# Intent

Expose start requirements before dispatch without granting execution authority. Share checks between reference workflow preview and actual start.

Out of scope: global legacy CLI admission, protected authority cutover, secure approval sessions, independent verification and release qualification.

# Basis

User authorized continuing friction improvements. RC.3 remains an unaccepted product candidate. OW94 defines the configured unverified execution seam. Existing required-start, exact-source, budget and writer protections remain binding.

# Work Order

## Deliverables
- Authenticated read-only admission API and browser action in apps/openwarrant-web.
- One shared check path, re-evaluated under execution lock at start.
- Public HTTP positive/refusal tests and bounded implementation notes.

## Limits
Preview is advisory and never reserves a writer, authenticates human approval, or grants dispatch. Worktree identity, exclusive claim and launch remain action-time checks. Unknown observations cannot produce ready. Preserve existing start refusals and all legacy records. No paid calls. Rollback by reverting this unsigned implementation.

# Assurance

### OBL-001 — preview does not launch or mutate

- **scope:** disposable HTTP/Git workflow fixtures.
- **evidence:** ready report, identical state bytes and absent writer registry.

### OBL-002 — start repeats shared checks

- **scope:** exact source, configured identity, completed work, required verification and unknown-cost fixtures.
- **evidence:** matching preview and action refusal reasons; prior ready result cannot restart completed work.

### OBL-003 — unavailable base remains unknown

- **scope:** nonexistent configured Git commit fixture.
- **evidence:** unknown preview, dispatch_permitted false, no attempts.
